41: Rather, Rava said - Do not teach that the reason of the baraita was “because of the lien” (shi’abuda), and only when it is his regular shopkeeper. For even when it is not his regular shopkeeper, a lien exists. However as for the house of R. Yannai there is no difficulty, as whether it was a regular shopkeeper or not.
Even though there is a lien - Assets to pay.
Since he did not designate a lien - He did not immediately designate money to him for this, it is not a proper exchange, and therefore the prohibition [of Shevi‘it does not transfer].
